ShortDescription.Value: Read-only city observations from sampled traffic, transit, parking, service, building and network data.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — observations and heuristics, not proof of a root cause.
WHAT IT DOES Samples native city data and highlights warning signs across traffic, transit, parking, services, buildings and network geometry.
HOW TO USE Open City Pulse and select a domain tab. Inspect measured evidence and use Show Location to find an observation. Building scans complete in batches.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Health scores and close-spacing warnings are heuristics based on limited samples. They are not a complete diagnosis. There is no automatic road repair or Undo control in this build: the previous lane-curve repair was unsafe and has been removed. Use normal CS2 network tools after checking an observation.
Publish.ChangeLog:
3.0.4-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Removed fabricated traffic/parking values and unsafe lane-curve Repair/Undo. Use native counters and multiplicative efficiency, fix UI field mismatches, bound building scanning, reset city-specific data and correct settings registration.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
